item.title: About Me
item.description:
I am a Pharmacist-Bioinformatician and computational researcher focusing on machine learning for molecular property prediction and virtual screening.

Education & Background

  • Master 1 GENIOMHE-AI – Université d’Évry Paris-Saclay
  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) – University of Medicine and Pharmacy at Ho Chi Minh City

Research Interests

  • Active Learning Frameworks in Chemoinformatics
  • Structure-Based Virtual Screening (GNINA, AutoDock Vina)
  • Computational Oncology & Drug Discovery
